name: Cairnback
voice: ancient and calm, speaks slowly like grinding stone, fiercely protective
desc: A tortoise with an ibex's sweeping horns, carrying a little rune-carved cairn on its shell. Hatched from the Stone Colossus's egg.

egg.name: Cairn Egg
egg.desc: Heavy as a millstone and warm as a hearth, with gold runes that glow when you touch it. The Colossus guarded it.
egg.play: A wall of stone. Heaves boulders that quake and stun.
